name: Crown Heights Assembly
caption: A four-fighter Brooklyn training team, built around a Jewish gym and its trainer, that produced SWIFT MMA's most storied run of upsets and injuries.

tenures.source: SWIFT's own roster bio cards' "TEAM RELEASE" fields and the "Who Are They? - Crown Heights Assembly" feature, all served this pass

name: Toofless Grin MMA
caption: An Irvine, California training team under head trainer Travis 'The King' Coy, whose fighters in training were Akeem Winters, Amon De Costa and Jamie Gregor.

tenures.source: SWIFT's own roster bio cards' "Team Name" and "Fighters In Training" fields (Akeem Winters, Amon De Costa), both served in this wing

notes: Head trainer Travis 'The King' Coy. Jamie 'TnT' Gregor is listed with Akeem Winters and Amon De Costa among the fighters in training on the team's bio card entries and appears in Winters' pre-fight roleplays.

name: East Coast Concrete Facilities
caption: A Wildwood, New Jersey training team of two fighters, one of whom (Ryoshi Hayatamei) fought at Retaliation 5.

tenures.source: SWIFT's own roster bio cards' "Team Name" fields (Ryoshi Hayatamei, Brutus Sovanoff), both served in this wing

notes: The bio cards of Brutus Sovanoff and Ryoshi Hayatamei give the training team as The Wrecking Crew and the team release as East Coast Concrete Facilities (ECCF), with Victor Backman as head trainer; Ravin Rich speaks for The Wrecking Crew in Hayatamei's Retaliation 5 roleplay.

identity.note: Shares the name The Wrecking Crew with the 1997 IWF tag team of Jeff Waller and Jason Jarrett. This one is a 2010 mixed-martial-arts training team whose fighters are Brutus Sovanoff and Ryoshi Hayatamei; no member, writer or page joins the two.

name: COBRA
caption: A Phoenix, Arizona training team of two fighters, one of whom (Bobby Walker) fought at Retaliation 5 and was billed for One Shot at Glory.

tenures.source: SWIFT's own roster bio cards' "Team Name" fields (Bobby Walker, Jay Walker), both served in this wing

name: Crooked Smile MMA
caption: A Montreal training team of two fighters, one of whom (Landon Price) fought for SWIFT MMA's only crowned championship.

tenures.source: SWIFT's own roster bio cards' "Team Name" and "Fighters In Training" fields (Landon Price, Razik El-Tazan), both served in this wing
